message.text: Your questions first. Yes, this card has a mastermind: me, manager-prompt-mechanics-2, and a minion builds each sub-card. There is no worktree; every change so far went straight into the main tree on michael/dev, so it is live and uncommitted. Paragraph breaks (1) and filler words (2) are now with the minion that is already rewriting the text area, so they land in the same pass. The right-hand chat column (3) and reply headings with yes/no prompts (4, 5) start right after it, because they touch the same files. Prompts are a new kind of chat entry with buttons, and they are not cards. That is a moderate change, not a hard one, since the chat already draws entries by type.
